transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started on finalizing the delivery package for After the Floodlights. We have the current draft package listing a 52-minute master, 5.1 audio mix, English subtitles, worldwide availability, and a 90-second promo clip. The submission window closes at 5:00 PM Friday, and our final-delivery meeting is Thursday morning, so we need to make sure everything is locked down before then. Does anyone have any concerns or updates regarding the current package before I move toward approval?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a major issue before we move toward approval. I checked the platform's delivery portal after the current draft circulated, and the portal confirms that this title must be delivered as an exactly 48-minute master with stereo audio and both English and Spanish subtitle files. The portal response is still in my production inbox, but our current draft package doesn't match these specs at all — we have a 52-minute master, 5.1 audio, and only English subtitles. We'll need to address these discrepancies before the final-delivery meeting on Thursday.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag two more issues with the current draft package. I confirmed with the documentary's licensing administrator after the draft circulated that the release is permitted only in the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom — not worldwide as currently listed. Additionally, any promotional clip may be no longer than exactly 30 seconds, but our draft package specifies a 90-second promo clip. I haven't entered this confirmation in the rights log yet, but these are binding restrictions we need to correct before approval.

Update availability from worldwide to United States, Canada, and United Kingdom only, per licensing confirmation.
Trim the promotional clip from 90 seconds to no longer than 30 seconds, per licensing restriction.
Leila to enter the licensing administrator's territory and promo clip confirmation into the rights log before Thursday's final-delivery meeting.
